question: Will Ethereum (ETH) trade above $2,600 by September 1, 2026 (UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ETH-USD spot price on Coinbase reaches strictly above $2,600.00 at any point before September 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
- "No": Wins if the ETH-USD spot price on Coinbase does not reach strictly above $2,600.00 at any point before September 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
